scope: FIT-only retrospective method development; no CERT/OUTER evaluation or final-model fit
setting: Conformer primary, RF auxiliary, frozen 37D outputs
reference: Saved FIT-selected linear SELE C in each of the 20 outer contexts; same 5 saved train-12/validation-3 risk folds
reference_selection_limitation: C was previously selected using all FIT validation outcomes; this conditional diagnostic is not fully nested or independent confirmation
primary_lambda_reason: Fixed moderate member of the existing grid, specified before this experiment; other values are sensitivity analyses, not a post-hoc winner
primary_readout: Held-out FIT R_SE at exactly floor(0.5*n_s) accepted epochs per subject; lower is better
secondary_readout: Training and held-out hard-threshold oracle coverage at alpha, for diagnosis only; uses evaluation labels and is not a deployable or CERT-selected policy
aggregation: Mean of 20 context-specific risks; subject summaries average repeated appearances before reporting counts. Contexts overlap and are not independent replicates; no significance test
decision_rule: Report fixed lambda=1 comparison and all grid sensitivities; do not select a winner or trigger CERT/OUTER automatically
budget: Existing cumulative compute_budget.json; no reset; pilot estimate before full run
calibration: No new calibration: fixed-quota ranking and within-model hard thresholds use raw scores; no probability or certification claims
